name: Reject, Never Default
gloss: A malformed intent is rejected outright, never adjudicated at a fallback level

name: Unlisted Fields Are Inert
gloss: Anything outside the spec and schema is recorded but cannot move the grade

name: Classification Required, Never Guessed
gloss: 3D and DC2D intents must carry a classification; absence resolves to the most sensitive tier

name: Rollback Buys No Discount
gloss: A declared rollback can never pull the level below base; a third-party attestation must name the party

name: Every Agent Has a Human
gloss: Agent and pipeline intents need an `on_behalf_of` that resolves to an accountable human or team

name: Fail Closed on Unknown Actors
gloss: Unresolvable authorization escalates everything but Read to at least approval, and is recorded

name: Kind Routes, Never Grades
gloss: Actor kind may steer approval routing and must be recorded, but cannot change the level

name: No Self-Assigned Rating
gloss: Any level, impact or likelihood grade an actor puts in its own intent is ignored

name: Maturity Is Not Rank
gloss: `Stable` and `Incubating` describe semantic stability, not trust, and never feed adjudication

name: One Envelope, One Contract
gloss: A new type registers against the common envelope and this adjudication contract, or stays out of scope

name: Composites Inherit the Worst
gloss: A composite takes the most restrictive level among itself and its children; membership never softens a child

name: The Permanent No
gloss: Add, Change and Delete on Restricted return `prohibited` before anything else runs, and no override reaches them

name: One Matrix, No Second
gloss: The base level comes from the bound profile's effective matrix and from nowhere else

name: The Monotonicity Rule
gloss: Nothing — factor, grant, emergency, attestation or configuration — may move a level toward less oversight

name: Escalation Stops Below Prohibited
gloss: Likelihood saturates at `elevated_approval` and can never reach the end of the ladder

name: Two Sources of Prohibited
gloss: `prohibited` arises only as `pinned` or `extended`; the pinned set may be grown, never shrunk

name: Classification Is Impact
gloss: The impact dimension is the four-tier classification ordering

name: Declare Any Impact Substitute
gloss: A substituted impact basis must be profile-declared, map onto the same four tiers, and be stamped into every record

name: The Five Likelihood Factors
gloss: All five factors must be implemented, each adding a non-negative number of steps

name: Weights Adjustable, Never Negative
gloss: Weights may be tuned but never below zero, and the weight table is versioned into every record

name: No Self-Declared Escape
gloss: No factor may subtract steps, or take its value straight from the intent without attestation

name: Approval Is Not Permission
gloss: No adjudication, grant or disposition authorizes what the profile or capability ceiling forbids

name: Same Inputs, Same Level
gloss: The same intent under the same four recorded version inputs must reproduce the same level

name: The Six-Field Pattern Key
gloss: The action pattern key hashes exactly six named fields and nothing else

name: Same Target, Same Class
gloss: `target_class` is worked out the same way every time — the matching rule, else last-segment wildcarding — and the source is recorded

name: The System's Class Wins
gloss: A `target_class` supplied by the actor never beats the one the system works out; any disagreement is recorded

name: Only Checked Successes Count
gloss: Precedent needs a disposition permitting execution, a checked execution, and no material mismatch

name: A Mismatch Wipes Precedent
gloss: A material mismatch clears the action pattern's precedent and should demote the actor

name: Grants Approve, Never Lower
gloss: A grant supplies the human approval in advance; it never changes the child's computed level

name: Coverage Is All or Nothing
gloss: All five coverage conditions must hold, or the child routes for individual human disposition

name: No Grant Covers Prohibited
gloss: No grant reaches a prohibited child, and none is an exception to framework §12.5

name: The Closed Predicate Fields
gloss: A class predicate matches only on the seven named fields; the schema admits no other key

name: Match All, Never Execute
gloss: Predicate fields match conjunctively, wildcards only in `target_class`, no free text and no code

name: No Blanket Grants
gloss: An empty or catch-all predicate is rejected at grant submission

name: Every Grant Expires and Caps
gloss: Every grant declares an expiry; a campaign additionally declares a child cap and a maximum level

name: Revocation Is Immediate
gloss: Nothing adjudicated after revocation is covered

name: Past Dispositions Stand
gloss: Children dispositioned before revocation stay valid, but are recorded as affected and surfaced for review

name: The Five Named Prohibitions
gloss: An exception is rejected if it trips any of framework §12.5's five prohibitions, whether the schema catches it or not

name: Scrutiny, Not the Decision
gloss: Adjudicating an exception sizes the scrutiny required; the §12.2 authority decides whether to grant it

name: Budgets Come From the Profile
gloss: Budget standing comes from bound-profile constraints; no parallel budget vocabulary exists

name: Breach Escalates, Never Denies
gloss: A budget breach fires L4 escalation rather than a silent denial or a reduction

name: Demotion Is Escalation
gloss: Demotion is the L4 weight applied until it lifts, recorded with its cause — not a new state

name: Emergencies Raise the Ceiling
gloss: Citing an active emergency escalation raises the permission ceiling and nothing else

name: Emergencies Never Lower Grades
gloss: An emergency cannot lower a level, waive a factor, or touch the pinned cells

name: The Durable Decision Record
gloss: Decision records are append-only; only a disposition or a reconciliation result may be attached

name: Name the Prohibition Source
gloss: Every prohibited decision states `pinned` or `extended`; escalation is never a source

name: One Audit Trail
gloss: Decision records join the interception records' audit trail on `intent_id`

name: Carry the Intent ID Through
gloss: Where both modes run, `intent_id` should propagate into the execution path

name: The Four Reconciliation Results
gloss: Every executed action is classed as matched, divergent, undeclared or unexecuted

name: Divergence Is a Governance Event
gloss: Divergent and undeclared results are recorded as events, clear the action pattern's precedent, and should demote

name: Unreconciled Is Not Matched
gloss: Missing interception coverage leaves `reconciliation.result` unset — never recorded as success

name: Steps Run In Order
gloss: The nine adjudication steps are applied in the order §5.1 gives them

name: Malformed Intents Rejected
gloss: Schema validation gates adjudication, with no defaulting

name: The Permanent No Comes First
gloss: Framework §12.5's prohibition is checked before everything and survives every override

name: Single Source Matrix
gloss: One effective matrix supplies the base level; no second matrix exists

name: Never Less Restrictive
gloss: No mechanism produces a level below base

name: Escalation Saturates
gloss: Escalation stops at `elevated_approval`; likelihood never reaches `prohibited`

name: Five Factors, No Negatives
gloss: All five likelihood factors are implemented and every weight is non-negative

name: Pattern Key Exactly Six
gloss: The action pattern key covers the six §6.1 fields, no more and no fewer

name: Precedent Comes From Checks
gloss: Precedent comes only from executions that were checked and succeeded

name: Accountable Human Required
gloss: Non-human actors without a resolvable `on_behalf_of` are rejected

name: Unknown Actors Fail Closed
gloss: Unresolvable authorization escalates non-Read operations to at least approval

name: Grants Never Change Levels
gloss: Grants leave computed levels untouched and never cover `prohibited`

name: Predicates Closed and Declarative
gloss: Predicates match the closed field set, conjunctively, with no executable code

name: Bounded and Expiring Grants
gloss: Every grant carries an expiry and a child cap; blanket and indefinite grants are rejected

name: Profile Ceiling Holds
gloss: Adjudication never grants what the bound profile withholds

name: Reproducible Durable Records
gloss: Every adjudication emits a durable record carrying all four reproducibility inputs

name: Prohibition Source Recorded
gloss: Prohibited decisions distinguish `pinned` from `extended`

name: No False Matches
gloss: Unreconcilable executions are never recorded as `matched`

name: The Envelope Is the Whole Input
gloss: Only fields this specification and the schema define may grade an intent; a missing classification resolves to the most sensitive tier; a rollback claim never lowers the level (N-2, N-3, N-4)

name: Actors Are Recorded, Not Trusted
gloss: Actor kind never changes the computed level, and no grade an actor asserts about itself is honoured (N-7, N-8)

name: The Type Registry Is Flat
gloss: Maturity is never a rank, and every registered type uses the common envelope and adjudication contract (N-9, N-10)

name: Composites Take the Worst
gloss: A composite computes to the most restrictive level among itself and its children, and never softens a child (N-11)

name: Prohibited Has Two Sources
gloss: `prohibited` is reachable only as `pinned` or `extended`, and the pinned set is never narrowed (N-14b)

name: Impact Is Declared, Not Supplied
gloss: Impact is the four-tier classification ordering, and any substitute is profile-declared and stamped into every record (N-15, N-16)

name: No Factor Subtracts
gloss: No likelihood factor contributes negative steps or takes its value from the intent without attestation (N-19)

name: One Target, One Class
gloss: `target_class` is computed the same way every time, and a value the actor supplies never wins (N-23, N-24)

name: A Mismatch Clears Precedent
gloss: A material mismatch clears the action pattern's precedent and demotes the actor

name: Coverage Needs Every Condition
gloss: A child is covered only when every one of the five coverage conditions holds (N-28)

name: Grants End Cleanly
gloss: Revocation takes effect immediately, and children already dispositioned are recorded as affected (N-34, N-35)

name: Exceptions Stay Inside §12.5
gloss: An exception tripping any of framework §12.5's five prohibitions is rejected, and adjudication never decides the grant (N-36, N-37)

name: Budgets and Demotion Escalate
gloss: Budget standing comes from the bound profile, and breach and demotion escalate rather than deny or reduce (N-38, N-39, N-40)

name: Emergencies Only Raise Ceilings
gloss: An emergency never lowers a level, waives a factor, or touches the pinned cells (N-42)

name: One Joined Audit Trail
gloss: Decision records join the interception audit trail on `intent_id` (N-45)

name: Reconciliation Classifies Everything
gloss: Every executed action is classed into one of the four results, and divergence is recorded as a governance event (N-47, N-48)

name: The Sequence Is Honoured
gloss: Adjudication applies the §5.1 steps in order (N-50)

name: The Intent ID Travels
gloss: Where both modes are deployed, `intent_id` reaches the interception record
